title: Warm Beef and Flatbread Wrap
description: A simple and flavorful wrap filled with warm beef and crispy flatbread. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the beef broth, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes.
Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the beef mixture onto the flatbread and top with a squeeze of lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil.
Fold the flatbread in half to enclose the filling and serve immediately.
